infoPlist.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Forge reads your Apple Watch workouts to show duration, heart rate, and active calories on your session summary, and to offer Watch cardio for your cardio log.
infoPlist.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Forge saves your finished strength workouts, logged cardio, and the body measurements you log (weight, body fat, waist, height, lean body mass and BMI) to Apple Health. You can turn each off anytime in Profile.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Forge uses the camera to scan food barcodes and look up nutrition information.
